descripcion_es: Cómo contar lo que otra persona dijo: cambio de tiempos verbales, pronombres y referencias; say frente a tell.
resumen: Para contar lo que alguien dijo se usa said o told + (that) + la frase, normalmente retrasando un paso el tiempo verbal y adaptando pronombres y expresiones de tiempo y lugar.

filas: Past simple: He said (that) he worked there.
Pasado continuo: She said she was leaving.
Past perfect: He said he had finished.
would: She said she would call me.
could: He said he could swim.
the next day / the following day
the day before / the previous day

items: Say no lleva persona detrás: He said (that)…; si se quiere decir a quién, say to me. Tell lleva siempre persona: He told me (that)…
That es opcional: She said she was tired.
Si lo dicho sigue siendo verdad o el verbo introductorio está en presente, el tiempo puede no cambiar: He says he is tired; She said Madrid is the capital of Spain.

ejemplos.frase: “I'm hungry,” said Leo. → Leo said he was hungry.
ejemplos.traduccion: «Tengo hambre», dijo Leo. → Leo dijo que tenía hambre.

ejemplos.frase: She told me she had lost her phone.
ejemplos.traduccion: Me dijo que había perdido el móvil.

ejemplos.frase: They said they would come the next day.
ejemplos.traduccion: Dijeron que vendrían al día siguiente.

ejemplos.frase: My boss told us the meeting was cancelled.
ejemplos.traduccion: Mi jefa nos dijo que la reunión se había cancelado.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: She said me that she was tired.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: She told me that she was tired.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Con persona detrás se usa tell; say no admite «me» directamente.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: He told that he was busy.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: He said that he was busy.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Tell necesita la persona a la que se dice; sin ella se usa say.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: He said he will help me.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: He said he would help me.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Con verbo introductorio en pasado, will pasa normalmente a would (igual que «dijo que me ayudaría»).

ejercicios.frase: She ___ me that she was moving to Valencia.
respuestas: told

ejercicios.frase: He ___ that the shop was closed.
respuestas: said

ejercicios.frase: “I can't come.” → She said she ___ come.
respuestas: couldn't

ejercicios.enunciado: Elige la opción correcta (lo cuentas una semana después).
ejercicios.frase: “I'll see you tomorrow.” → He said he would see me ___.
respuestas: the next day
ejercicios.explicacion: Tomorrow pasa a the next day al contarlo después.

ejercicios.frase: “I live in Bilbao.” → Ana said she ___ in Bilbao.
respuestas: lived
lives
ejercicios.explicacion: Presente simple → past simple (lives también es posible si sigue viviendo allí).

ejercicios.frase: “We are watching TV.” → They said they ___ TV.
respuestas: were watching

ejercicios.frase: “I have finished the project.” → He said he ___ the project.
respuestas: had finished
'd finished

ejercicios.frase: The teacher ___ us that the exam was on Friday.
respuestas: told

ejercicios.frase: He said me that he was ill.
respuestas: He told me that he was ill.
He told me he was ill.
He said to me that he was ill.
ejercicios.explicacion: Say no va seguido directamente de persona: told me o said to me.

ejercicios.frase: Maria told that she liked the film.
respuestas: Maria said that she liked the film.
Maria said she liked the film.
ejercicios.explicacion: Sin persona tras el verbo se usa said.

ejercicios.enunciado: Pasa a estilo indirecto empezando por «She said».
respuestas: She said she was very tired.
She said that she was very tired.

ejercicios.enunciado: Pasa a estilo indirecto empezando por «Tom said» (lo cuentas días después).
respuestas: Tom said he would call me that night.
Tom said that he would call me that night.
Tom said he'd call me that night.
Tom said that he'd call me that night.
ejercicios.explicacion: Will → would; you → me; tonight → that night.

respuestas: she told me she was busy
ejercicios.explicacion: Told + persona + (that) + frase con el tiempo retrasado.

respuestas: they said they had lost the keys
